Check out this series of blog posts to learn how the detection engine works: 1. [Regex is all you need](https://lookingatcomputer.substack.com/p/regex-is-almost-all-you-need), 2. [Rare Not Random](https://lookingatcomputer.substack.com/p/rare-not-random), 3. [Express YourCELf](https://lookingatcomputer.substack.com/p/express-yourcelf-filtering-and-val
